THE IMAGE CONTAINS A FEW CLOUDS BUT DUE TO THE SATELLITE REPRESENTATION AND THE PREVIOUS REPORTS FOR THIS AREA, OUR CONFIDENCE IS HIGH. WINDS WERE ENE AROUND 10-15KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: NONE.

Report Description***POTENTIAL RELEASE*** CALLER REPORTING THAT ON MONDAY 29JUL2019 AT 0845 ONE OF THEIR WORK VANS WAS INVOLVED IN A 2 CAR MOTOR VEHICLE ACCIDENT RESULTING IN A ROLLOVER. THE VAN WAS TRANSPORTING RADIOACTIVE ISOTOPES STORED IN AMMO CANS NONE OF WHICH CAME OUT OF THE VAN DURRING THE ACCIDENT. THERE WAS ONE LEAD CASING CONTAINING COBALT 57 THAT WAS FOUND OUTSIDE THE VAN. AFTER AN INVESTIGATION IT WAS CONCLUDED THAT THERE WAS NO RELEASE OF RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS. HOWEVER THERE IS A POTENTIAL RELEASE OF COLBALT, A WIPE TEST OF THE LEAD CASING WAS CONDUCTED AND THE SRP IS AWAITING THE RESULTS OF THAT TEST. RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS IN THE VAN WERE - COBALT 57, TECHNETIUM-99M, ***POTENTIAL RELEASE***

THE ANOMALY ALSO TESTED NEGATIVE FOR POSSIBLE VEGETATION SIGNATURES. DUE TO THE FACT THAT OCEAN CURRENTS AND SURFACE WINDS DO NOT MATCH THE ORIENTATION OF THE SLICK, CONFIDENCE IS REDUCED TO MEDIUM
